description: No clean concept found. The strongest tendency: it fires when the opponent's last stone went into column 4 while column 5 is still empty, most strongly in the opening (e.g. 3,1,6,4). Much of its firing near threshold happens in mid and late games with no shared board pattern I could find, so this rule catches only about a fifth of firing.
effect: None measurable: forcing it to zero or to its maximum moves no column's probability by more than 0.01 (tested on 4 positions).
notes: Layer 1, pole -. Tried: last col 4 landing on floor/own stone (F1 0.14), last4&col5 empty or last5&col4 empty (0.14), weighted score with early ply (0.13), col5 gap between filled cols 4 and 6 (0.13), last col 4 & col 5 empty (0.17, best; AUROC 0.58; sim share -0.03). Top band is dominated by last move col 4 and col 5 empty in openings, but bands 5-6 are mostly neither. Activation flips on and off from move to move in mid-game. Not mirror-symmetric. No steering effect. Synthesis best 1.359 < dev max 1.618. Likely a mixture or random direction.
